choose.when: AND (iaad.system_role_type is null or iaad.system_role_type = '' or iaad.system_role_type = 'LEIT_empty')
AND (iaad.access_label is null or iaad.access_label = '' or iaad.access_label = 'LEIT_empty')

where.if:
AND mgr.management_level
not in ('Executive Director', 'Vice President', 'Senior Vice President', 'Executive Vice President', 'Chief Executive Officer')
in ('Executive Director')
in ('Vice President')
in ('Senior Vice President', 'Executive Vice President', 'Chief Executive Officer')

mapper.sql: iaad.cmdb_id as cmdbId, iaad.application_name as appName, iaad.user_it_code as itCodeOfUser, staff.real_name as userRealName, iaad.system_role_id as systemRoleId, iaad.system_role as systemRole, iaad.role_description as roleDescription, iaad.line_manager as lineManager, iaad.line_manager_email as lineManagerEmail, iaad.bpo as bpo, iaad.bpo_email as bpoEmail
mapper.select:
SELECT iaad.access_label AS accessLabel,
CASE WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'LEIT_empty' THEN null WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'function' THEN '功能' WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'data' THEN '数据' WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'function/data' THEN '功能/数据' ELSE iaad.system_role_type END AS systemRoleType,
CASE WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'LEIT_empty' THEN null ELSE iaad.system_role_type END AS systemRoleType,
CASE WHEN mgr.management_level IN ('Executive Director') THEN 'ED' WHEN mgr.management_level IN ('Vice President') THEN 'VP' WHEN mgr.management_level IN ('Senior Vice President', 'Executive Vice President', 'Chief Executive Officer') THEN 'SVP and above' ELSE 'Director and below' END as lineManagerLevelCode,
FROM its_application_access_data as iaad left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 staff on iaad.user_it_code = staff.user_name LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 mgr ON iaad.line_manager = mgr.user_name
ORDER BY ${request.sortField} ${request.sortOrder}

SELECT DISTINCT iaad.cmdb_id as cmdbId, iaad.application_name as appName, iaad.system_role_id as systemRoleId, iaad.system_role as systemRole, iaad.role_description as roleDescription, iaad.access_label AS accessLabel,
CASE WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'LEIT_empty' THEN null WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'function' THEN '功能' WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'data' THEN '数据' WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'function/data' THEN '功能/数据' ELSE iaad.system_role_type END AS systemRoleType,
CASE WHEN iaad.system_role_type = 'LEIT_empty' THEN null ELSE iaad.system_role_type END AS systemRoleType,
iaad.bpo as bpo, iaad.bpo_email as bpoEmail FROM its_application_access_data as iaad
AND iaad.cmdb_id = #{request.cmdbId}
AND iaad.cmdb_id IN
#{item}
order by systemRole
